title: INMOTION X1
body_html:
• Pre-Order for $3,699 + $597 in Bonuses. Available 10/20-12/31, 2026. Includes an extra year of battery, motor and controller warranty ($399 value; 2 years total), an X1 seat ($159 value), and 2 years of RideConnect access ($39 value).
  • 235.2 V Max Platform. 340 N·m Max Torque. With 6 kW rated power and 20 kW peak power, X1 is built for steep starts, low-speed obstacles and technical climbs.
  • EVE 50PL Cells. 16A Fast Charger Included. A 2,100 Wh battery with high-discharge EVE 50PL cells delivers 43+ miles (70+ km) in mixed-road testing. The included 16A charger takes the battery from 0-90% in approximately 35 minutes.
  • 150 mm Adjustable Suspension. Progressive linkage provides 150 mm total travel for repeated impacts over roots, rocks and ruts. Adjustable settings and three pedal heights let you tailor your setup.
  • Modular Design. Replaceable Protection. Protective parts can be replaced individually after off-road wear or damage. Tire changes do not require unplugging the motor cable, and battery packs can be disconnected separately.
